audience: A freelancer importing a bank CSV for the first time
task: A help page: export a CSV from your bank and import it, including what to do when columns do not match.
facts: Supported banks: 9 named in a table (Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, NatWest, Santander, Monzo, Starling, Nationwide, Revolut)
Required columns: date, description, amount (or paid in and paid out)
Files up to 5 MB or 10,000 lines
A mismatched column opens a mapping screen; the mapping is remembered per bank
Duplicates within 3 days of each other with the same amount are flagged, not deleted
